title: W3C Trace Context (traceparent header)
summary: The W3C Trace Context standard defines the traceparent HTTP header: 'traceparent: {version}-{trace-id}-{parent-id}-{trace-flags}'. Version is 2 hex chars (00), trace-id is 32 hex chars (128-bit), parent-id is 16 hex chars (64-bit span ID), trace-flags is 2 hex chars (01 = sampled).

notes: trace-flags: 01 = sampled (trace is recorded), 00 = not sampled.
Used in HTTP headers for distributed tracing propagation.
